title: Weak pure infiniteness and Cuntz-algebra absorption

result.label: Weak pure infiniteness and Cuntz-algebra absorption
result.statement: Resolves the ordinary-to-strong pure-infiniteness question of Kirchberg and Rørdam for complex C ∗ -algebras. For exact algebras, proper infiniteness of one fixed finite amplification of every positive element also suffices. Consequently, every separable nuclear algebra with this property absorbs O , without unitality or simplicity assumptions.
